## Since 1987, Omaxe has shaped trusted real estate destinations across India.

Omaxe Limited began with construction and contracting in 1987,
entered real estate in 2001, and became listed on BSE and NSE in 2007.

Omaxe Group plans residential and business environments across growing
Indian cities, combining township homes, group housing, SCO streets, retail hubs, malls
and office spaces with clear location logic, delivery discipline and customer-first
communication.

Omaxe Journey

## Founded on Execution and Trust.

Omaxe began with a strong construction foundation and grew by focusing on
dependable execution, practical planning and relationships built over time.
That experience continues to guide how the group approaches residential,
retail and commercial real estate.

Each project is shaped around clear development goals, usable spaces and
long-term relevance for families, entrepreneurs and investors.

![Omaxe planned growth across India](https://omaxe-group.com/images/resource/journey-planned-growth.webp)

Omaxe Journey

## Planned Growth Across India.

Omaxe's growth across Indian cities is driven by location-led planning,
infrastructure awareness and an understanding of how people live, shop, work
and invest.

The portfolio brings together townships, homes, SCO spaces, retail
environments and office destinations designed to support everyday
convenience and future demand.

## Real Estate Solutions for Homebuyers, Businesses and Investors.

Each shortlisted property should be reviewed for actual use: how the
layout works, how the location connects, which documents are available and whether
the project status matches the buyer's timeline.
